decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted, (two plans C5550/M/701 rev. A and 703 rev. A, received: 2 November 2010 and amended plan C5550/M/702 rev B received: 14 December 2010) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the air conditioning plant is used.

Condition : 3 - The noise generated from the external plant (air condenser units), shall be not less than 10dB(A) below the existing background noise level (LAeq), when measured from the nearest noise sensitive receptor, over any 24-hour period.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until full details of landscaping works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.  Landscape works shall include planting plans and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment and an implementation programme.
description: Installation of air conditioning plant and equipment in fenced compounds to the side and rear of the hotel
